professionalSummary.text: Owns the workflow system's runtime platform end-to-end and decides and executes production configuration changes.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned the runtime platform for the credit workflow system for three years, deciding and executing production configuration changes to the Kubernetes clusters myself as the platform's named owner, with the change record carrying my approval and my execution.

experienceHighlights.text: Builds and maintains the platform's infrastructure code and deployment pipelines.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built and maintained the platform's infrastructure code (Terraform, Helm charts) and the deployment pipelines that promote the workflow application through test, staging and production.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Led the weekly platform change review and records decisions.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Led the weekly platform change review, deciding which application and platform changes were scheduled into the production window and recording the decisions in the change-review log.

skills.text: Coordinates changes with the application team and security and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Coordinated changes with the application team and security, recording that the application team owned application configuration and security owned the policy baseline while I owned the cluster configuration and the production window.
